description: This file contains validation and evaluation functions for a YOLO-based object detection model, including coordinate conversion, batch processing, and metrics calculation.

methods.name: xywh2xyxy(box_coord : torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Converts bounding box coordinates from center_x, center_y, width, height to x_1, y_1, x_2, y_2 format.

methods.name: process_batch(detections, labels, iouv)
methods.description: Processes a batch of detections and labels to determine correct predictions for multiple IoU thresholds.

methods.name: run(model, val_dataloader, num_class, net_dim=416, nms_thresh=0.6, objectness_thresh=0.001, device="cpu")
methods.description: Main validation loop that performs inference, applies NMS, and computes mAP and other metrics for the model.

ctags.name: run
ctags.pattern: /^def run(model, val_dataloader, num_class, net_dim=416, nms_thresh=0.6, objectness_thresh=0.001, /
ctags.signature: (model, val_dataloader, num_class, net_dim=416, nms_thresh=0.6, objectness_thresh=0.001, device="cpu")
